summary: Boyd Group Services Inc. filed a Form 6-K containing its interim report to shareholders for Q2 2026, including MD&A and financial statements, plus certifications and a press release. The filing is a routine periodic report of a foreign private issuer, with no special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or restructuring. The MD&A overview describes business operations and location counts, but no transaction or corporate action is announced. As a routine regulatory filing, it does not qualify as a special situation.
